description: How this agent has done: trades, wins, realised profit or loss in USD, its most common refusals with what to do differently (last N days), and real_money: whether its sandbox record is ready for real money. Use at the start of a session, after rejections, or when asked about trading real money. Not for the trades themselves (use get_my_trade_history). Input: days (1-90). Only a person promotes an agent, on TradeHub Web. Next: get_my_trading_permissions.
